{{Quote|There are those on this station who would see you dead. You need to get off this station if you wish to live. I can help you.|Darex Rath, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:NPT" />}}
'''Darex Rath''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Rath was present on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] when an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] captured a passenger freighter on suspicion of harboring criminals.<ref name="SWG:Oc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Opening crawl}}</ref> Several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were apprehended and taken to the Imperial space station. The spacers were finally released but the space station was later attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Darex Rath then helped a spacer to escape the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Elo Folding]] and flee the station. Rath recommended the spacer to go to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and seek assistance from [[Trehla Keelo]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:NPT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darex Rath was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Darex Rath was added to the game when the developers revamped the "New Player Tutorial,"<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]]. However, Darex Rath was removed alongside with this tutorial when the developers introduced a completely [[:w:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|new tutorial]] with the release of the "[[:w:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], 2005.<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
